2608.14107.title: Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning for Dense Retrieval
2608.14107.paper_summary: Reasoning-intensive retrieval requires text representations to capture not only semantic similarity, but also the reasoning needed to determine relevance under a given retrieval instruction. Existing reasoning-enhanced embedding models improve retrieval by incorporating reasoning information into dense representations, yet their supervision is typically dominated by the final retrieval objective. As a result, latent reasoning trajectories may learn shortcut reasoning patterns that preserve retrieval performance without producing meaningful incremental retrieval gains. We propose Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning (RGLT), a latent reasoning framework for dense retrieval that explicitly connects intermediate latent transitions with retrieval improvements. RGLT performs non-autoregressive reasoning in hidden space through an instruction-conditioned latent reasoning trajectory constructed from silent tokens. It combines process-supervised explicit-to-implicit distillation with retrieval-grounded supervision, using stage-wise CoT reconstruction to shape intermediate latent states and retrieval-effect credit to optimize incremental retrieval gains across the latent reasoning trajectories. Experiments on reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks show that RGLT consistently outperforms strong baselines while preserving efficient embedding inference.
2608.14107.paper_summary_zh: 推理密集型檢索需要文本表示來捕捉不僅是語義相似性，還有在給定檢索指令下確定相關性所需的推理。現有的增強推理嵌入模型通過將推理信息納入密集表示來改善檢索，但它們的監督通常受到最終檢索目標的主導。因此，潛在的推理軌跡可能會學習保留檢索性能的捷徑推理模式，而不產生有意義的增量檢索增益。我們提出了檢索基礎潛在推理（RGLT），這是一個明確將中間潛在轉換與檢索改進連接的密集檢索潛在推理框架。RGLT通過從靜默標記構建的指令條件潛在推理軌跡，在隱藏空間中執行非自回歸推理。它結合了過程監督的顯式到隱式蒸餾與檢索基礎的監督，使用階段性CoT重建來塑造中間潛在狀態，並利用檢索效果信用來優化潛在推理軌跡中的增量檢索增益。在推理密集型檢索基準上的實驗顯示，RGLT始終優於強基準，同時保持高效的嵌入推理。
